tagline.zh: 從透析室的早晨到那通高血鉀的電話
tagline.en: From a morning in the dialysis unit to the potassium call

desc.zh: 找基準值、看尿量、接危急值電話、自己看尿沉渣。
desc.en: Find the baseline, watch the urine output, take the critical-value calls, look at the urine sediment yourself.

desc.zh: 廔管、機器、上機與下機都在你手上。病人每週見你三次，比見家人還多。
desc.en: Fistulas, machines, putting on and taking off: all yours. Patients see you three times a week, more than their families.

about.zh: 腎臟科主治，口袋裡有一本小筆記，記著每個病人的基準肌酸酐。開口第一句永遠是「舊值呢？」
about.en: Nephrologist with a pocket notebook of every patient's baseline creatinine. His first words are always 'and the old value?'

about.zh: 透析室二十年，閉著眼睛摸廔管就知道是誰。對機器講話，機器也聽她的。
about.en: Twenty years in the dialysis unit; can tell whose fistula it is with her eyes shut. Talks to the machines, and the machines listen.

about.zh: 75 歲退休漁夫，腹瀉三天後全身無力，腰痠就吃女婿買的止痛藥。堅稱「我的腎以前好好的」，但沒有人找得到舊報告。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 75-year-old retired fisherman, weak after three days of diarrhoea, taking his son-in-law's painkillers for backache. Insists his kidneys 'used to be fine', but nobody can find an old report. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 在漁會上班，中午會帶便當來。家裡的抽屜她翻了一整晚。
about.en: Works at the fishermen's association and brings lunch boxes at noon. She spent all night going through the drawers at home.

about.zh: 68 歲，慢性腎病洗腎兩年，每週一三五報到。昨天孫子生日吃了很多水果。今天覺得心臟「怪怪的」。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 68-year-old on dialysis for two years, Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays. Ate a lot of fruit at her grandson's birthday yesterday. Says her heart feels 'odd' today. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 32 歲外送員，一週前尿變成茶色，眼皮腫，急診量到高血壓。覺得自己只是太累。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 32-year-old delivery rider: tea-coloured urine for a week, puffy eyelids, and a high blood pressure found in the ER. Thinks he is just tired. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 打危急值電話的人。會要求你複誦，一個字都不能少。
about.en: The voice behind the critical-value calls. Makes you read the value back, every digit.

about.zh: 5 床的主責護理師，尿壺量得比誰都準。
about.en: Bed 5's primary nurse. Nobody measures a urine bottle more precisely.

plain.zh: 肌肉代謝的廢物，靠腎臟排掉。腎功能變差它就在血裡堆高，但要跟舊值比才知道是新還是舊的問題。
plain.en: A waste product from muscle, cleared by the kidneys. It rises in the blood when they fail, but only a comparison with an old value tells you whether the problem is new.

plain.zh: 病人平常的數值。沒有基準值，你分不出急性腎損傷和多年的慢性腎病。
plain.en: The patient's usual number. Without a baseline you cannot tell an acute kidney injury from years of chronic disease.

plain.zh: 腎功能在幾天內突然變差。原因通常不只一個：缺水、藥物、尿路阻塞都可能同時參與。
plain.en: Kidney function falling over days. Usually more than one cause at once: dehydration, drugs and a blocked outflow can all take part.

plain.zh: 腎臟最誠實的即時報告。每一小時有多少，比明天早上的抽血更早告訴你方向。
plain.en: The kidney's most honest live report. How much comes out each hour tells you the direction before tomorrow's blood test.

plain.zh: 手臂上用手術把動脈和靜脈接起來的血管，是洗腎病人的生命線。每次上機前都要看、摸、聽。
plain.en: A surgically joined artery and vein in the arm, the dialysis patient's lifeline. Before every session: look, feel, listen.

plain.zh: 用機器代替腎臟，把血引出來清掉廢物和多餘的水和鉀，再送回去。
plain.en: A machine standing in for the kidneys: blood is drawn out, cleaned of waste, excess water and potassium, and returned.

plain.zh: 血液裡的一種電解質。太高會讓心臟跳得慢、跳得亂，甚至停下來。洗腎病人特別容易高。
plain.en: An electrolyte in the blood. Too high and the heart slows, beats irregularly or stops. Dialysis patients are especially prone to it.

plain.zh: 抽血時紅血球被弄破，細胞裡的鉀跑進血清，數值會假性偏高。但檢體有問題，不代表病人沒問題。
plain.en: Red cells broken during the blood draw leak potassium into the serum and falsely raise the number. A faulty sample does not mean a healthy patient.

plain.zh: 檢驗室看到可能立即危及生命的數字，會直接打電話給醫師，對方要複誦確認。
plain.en: A laboratory result that could threaten life right now. The lab phones the doctor directly and the doctor reads the value back.

plain.zh: 記錄心臟電活動的圖。高血鉀會先在心電圖上留下痕跡，比症狀更早。
plain.en: A recording of the heart's electrical activity. High potassium leaves its mark on the ECG before it causes symptoms.

plain.zh: 尿排不出去，往上堆回腎臟，超音波看到腎盂被撐大。代表下游有東西塞住。
plain.en: Urine backing up into the kidney because it cannot drain; on ultrasound the collecting system looks stretched. Something downstream is blocked.

plain.zh: 把尿離心後沉在底部的東西，拿去顯微鏡下看。腎臟科醫師自己看，因為裡面有腎絲球的線索。
plain.en: What settles at the bottom after spinning the urine, examined under the microscope. Nephrologists look themselves, because the glomerular clues are in there.

plain.zh: 形狀被擠壞的紅血球。表示血是從腎絲球濾出來的，不是從膀胱或尿道流的。
plain.en: Red cells squashed out of shape. They show the blood came through the kidney's filters, not from the bladder or urethra.

plain.zh: 紅血球在腎小管裡被壓成一條條的模子。看到它，出血幾乎一定來自腎臟本身。
plain.en: Red cells moulded into little cylinders inside the kidney tubules. See one and the bleeding is almost certainly from the kidney itself.

plain.zh: 肺出血和腎絲球發炎一起出現，常是同一個免疫疾病在攻擊兩個器官。要緊急整合處理。
plain.en: Lung bleeding and kidney inflammation appearing together, often one immune disease attacking two organs. It needs urgent joined-up care.

text.zh: 幫浦、透析器、管路和一排警報燈。處方由團隊設定；上機前它會自檢，自檢沒過就不接病人。阿玉說它只是比較囉嗦，不是故障。
text.en: Pump, dialyser, tubing and a row of alarm lights. The prescription is the team's; before each session it self-tests, and a failed test means no patient is connected. Nurse Yu says it is chatty, not broken.

text.zh: 腎臟科用它回答一個問題：尿有沒有排出去？腎臟長軸看腎盂有沒有撐大、膀胱有沒有脹滿。兩分鐘，改變整個診斷。
text.en: The nephrologist uses it to answer one question: is the urine getting out? The long axis of the kidney shows a stretched pelvis; the bladder shows retention. Two minutes that change the whole diagnosis.

text.zh: 護理站角落的那台。離心、倒掉上清、取一滴沉渣、蓋玻片、低倍找圓柱、高倍看紅血球形狀。周主治說這是腎臟科的聽診器。
text.en: The one in the corner of the station. Spin, decant, one drop of sediment, coverslip, low power for casts, high power for red-cell shape. Dr Chou calls it the nephrologist's stethoscope.

text.zh: 每張透析椅都有一台。心跳變慢、波形變寬，在病人說「怪怪的」之前就看得到。
text.en: One at every dialysis chair. A slowing pulse and a widening waveform are visible before the patient says anything feels 'odd'.

text.zh: 床尾那張紙。每小時喝了多少、尿了多少。沒有這張表，你對腎臟的了解只剩明天早上的一管血。
text.en: The sheet at the foot of the bed: what went in and what came out, hour by hour. Without it, all you know about the kidney is tomorrow morning's blood tube.

text.zh: 小芬翻了一整晚抽屜找到的，三年前漁會健檢。上面有一個肌酸酐。有了它，急性和慢性終於分得開。
text.en: Found by Fen after a night of going through drawers: the fishermen's association health check from three years ago. It has a creatinine on it. With it, acute and chronic can finally be told apart.

text.zh: 一個肌酸酐數字沒有意義，兩個才有。先找舊值：其他醫院、健檢、捐血、保險體檢。找不到，就把尿量和趨勢當基準。
text.en: One creatinine means nothing; two mean something. Hunt for the old value: other hospitals, health checks, blood donation, insurance medicals. If there is none, the urine output and the trend become your baseline.

name.zh: 急性腎損傷的三個問題
name.en: Three questions for acute kidney injury

text.zh: 進水夠不夠（容量）、有沒有東西在傷腎（藥物、顯影劑、感染）、尿排得出去嗎（阻塞）。三個都要問，因為答案常常不只一個。
text.en: Is enough getting in (volume)? Is something hurting the kidney (drugs, contrast, infection)? Can urine get out (obstruction)? Ask all three, because the answer is often more than one.

note.en: Took over Mr Hai in bed 5

guide.en: Hear the handover at the board

lines.zh: （擴音）5 床阿海伯，75 歲，腹瀉三天後無力，昨晚入院。肌酸酐偏高，沒有舊值可以比。
lines.en: (On speaker) Bed 5, Mr Hai, 75, weak after three days of diarrhoea, admitted last night. Creatinine raised, and there is no old value to compare.

lines.zh: 腰痠一直吃女婿買的止痛藥。他說他的腎以前好好的。
lines.en: Takes his son-in-law's painkillers for backache. Says his kidneys used to be fine.

lines.zh: 「以前好好的」不是基準值。舊值呢？
lines.en: 'Used to be fine' is not a baseline. And the old value?

lines.zh: 找不到。他沒在我們醫院看過。
lines.en: None. He has never been seen here.

guide.zh: 跟周主治討論怎麼開始
guide.en: Discuss the plan with Dr Chou

lines.zh: 一個肌酸酐沒有意義，兩個才有。沒有舊值的時候，你拿什麼當基準？
lines.en: One creatinine means nothing; two mean something. With no old value, what do you use as a baseline?

lines.zh: ……他的尿量？還有今天和明天的趨勢。
lines.en: ...His urine output? And the trend from today to tomorrow.

lines.zh: 對。來，把線索排一排。
lines.en: Right. Line up the clues.

post.zh: 好。女兒中午會來，請她回家翻抽屜：健檢、捐血、保險體檢，什麼都好。
post.en: Good. His daughter comes at noon; ask her to go through the drawers at home. Health checks, blood donation, insurance medicals, anything.

guide.en: Sort the orders at the station

lines.zh: 阿海伯的藥單攤在桌上。止痛藥、降血壓藥、一包女婿買的藥局成藥。
lines.en: Mr Hai's drug list lies on the desk: painkillers, blood-pressure tablets, and a packet of pharmacy pills from the son-in-law.

q.zh: 沒有基準值的急性腎損傷，第一張醫囑寫什麼？
q.en: Acute kidney injury with no baseline. What is your first order?

options.zh: 停止痛藥、審藥單、每小時尿量表
options.en: Stop the painkillers, review the list, hourly urine chart

why.zh: 先把正在傷腎的東西拿掉，然後讓腎臟每小時給你報告。這比任何一管血都早。
why.en: Remove what is hurting the kidney now, then let the kidney report to you hourly. That is earlier than any blood tube.

options.zh: 先大量補水，明早再抽血

why.zh: 缺水可能只是原因之一。沒有尿量表，你補的水進去之後去了哪裡，沒有人知道。
why.en: Dehydration may be only one cause. Without a urine chart nobody knows where the fluid you give actually goes.

why.zh: 透析是回答問題之後的工具，不是問題本身。他現在沒有透析的緊急指徵。
why.en: Dialysis is a tool for after the questions are answered, not a substitute for them. He has no emergency indication now.

guide.en: See Mrs Chang at her chair

lines.zh: 阿玉，今天心臟怪怪的，跳得好像比較慢。昨天孫子生日，我吃了很多水果，不要罵我。
lines.en: Yu, my heart feels odd today, slower somehow. It was my grandson's birthday yesterday and I ate a lot of fruit. Do not scold me.

lines.zh: 我不罵，我記下來。先給我手臂。
lines.en: No scolding, just writing it down. Arm first.

lines.zh: 「心臟怪怪的」加「很多水果」，你想到什麼？記著，等一下會用到。
lines.en: 'Heart feels odd' plus 'a lot of fruit'. What comes to mind? Hold that thought; you will need it.

guide.en: Assess the fistula before connecting

lines.zh: 每一次上機前評估動靜脈廔管：看、摸、聽。看紅腫，摸震顫，聽雜音。廔管是她的命。
lines.en: Before every session, assess the AV fistula: look, feel, listen. Look for redness, feel for the thrill, listen for the bruit. The fistula is her life.

post.zh: 震顫在，雜音連續，沒有紅腫。可以穿刺。機器自檢也過了，它今天心情不錯。
post.en: Thrill present, continuous bruit, no redness. Safe to needle. The machine passed its self-test too; it is in a good mood today.

guide.en: Write Mr Hai's admission assessment

lines.zh: 你把三個問題寫成三行：進水夠不夠、有沒有東西在傷腎、尿排得出去嗎。第三行你還沒有答案。
lines.en: You write the three questions as three lines: enough going in, anything hurting the kidney, can urine get out. The third line has no answer yet.

lines.zh: （經過）第三行空著很好。空著就代表你會去回答它。
lines.en: (Passing) Good that the third line is blank. Blank means you will go and answer it.

note.zh: 超音波發現阿海伯水腎

guide.en: See Mr Hai at bed 5

lines.zh: 醫師，我出海四十年沒住過院。拉肚子而已，怎麼住進來了？
lines.en: Doctor, forty years at sea and never in hospital. It was just diarrhoea, how did I end up here?

lines.zh: 阿海伯，你最近尿尿順嗎？有沒有要等很久、滴滴答答？
lines.en: Mr Hai, has passing urine been easy lately? Any waiting, any dribbling?

lines.zh: 男人老了都這樣啦。晚上起來四五次，每次都一點點。
lines.en: All old men are like that. Up four or five times a night, a little each time.

lines.zh: 聽到了嗎？「每次都一點點」。第三個問題，去拿超音波。
lines.en: Did you hear that? 'A little each time'. The third question. Fetch the ultrasound.

guide.en: Ultrasound: long axis of the kidney

lines.zh: 側躺，探頭放在腰側，找腎臟長軸。你要看的是腎盂有沒有被撐開。
lines.en: On his side, probe on the flank, find the long axis of the kidney. You are looking for a stretched collecting system.

post.zh: 兩邊水腎，膀胱脹得像顆球。他不是「只有」缺水和止痛藥，他的尿根本出不去。
post.en: Hydronephrosis on both sides and a bladder like a football. He is not 'just' dehydrated on painkillers; his urine cannot get out at all.

post.zh: 三個原因同時存在。放導尿管解除阻塞，然後看尿量。
post.en: All three causes at once. A catheter to relieve the obstruction, then watch the urine output.

post.zh: 導尿管？……好啦，只要不是開刀。
post.en: A catheter? ...Fine, as long as it is not an operation.

guide.zh: 接檢驗科電話，回報師傅
guide.en: Take the lab call, report to the mentor

sub.zh: 張阿姨血鉀危急值，檢體註記溶血
sub.en: Mrs Chang: critical potassium, sample flagged haemolysed

lines.zh: 檢驗科小高。張阿姨上機前那管血，血鉀危急值，但檢體有溶血註記。請複誦。
lines.en: Kao from the lab. Mrs Chang's pre-dialysis sample: potassium at critical level, but the sample is flagged haemolysed. Please read back.

lines.zh: 張阿姨，血鉀危急值，檢體溶血，通知時間記錄了。謝謝。
lines.en: Mrs Chang, critical potassium, haemolysed sample, time of notification recorded. Thank you.

lines.zh: 溶血檢體會假性偏高。所以這通電話可以不理嗎？她早上說了什麼？
lines.en: A haemolysed sample reads falsely high. So can this call be ignored? What did she tell you this morning?

lines.zh: 心臟怪怪的、跳得慢、昨天吃很多水果。
lines.en: Heart feels odd, slower, and a lot of fruit yesterday.

post.zh: 對。檢體有問題不代表病人沒問題。心電圖、重抽，兩個同時做，不是先後。
post.en: Right. A faulty sample does not mean a healthy patient. ECG and a repeat sample, both at once, not one after the other.

guide.en: Check Mrs Chang on the monitor

lines.zh: 心電圖貼好了。你看波形，她的心跳在變慢，T 波變尖。
lines.en: ECG leads are on. Look at the trace: her rate is slowing and the T waves are peaking.

lines.zh: 我是不是不該吃那些水果……
lines.en: I should not have eaten all that fruit, should I...

options.zh: 叫師傅、依醫囑處理高血鉀、準備透析、持續心電圖
options.en: Call the mentor, treat the potassium per orders, prepare dialysis, continuous ECG

why.zh: 症狀加心電圖變化，等不到重抽結果。透析是她最有效的排鉀方法，而且機器就在旁邊。
why.en: Symptoms plus ECG changes do not wait for the repeat result. Dialysis is her most effective way to clear potassium, and the machine is right there.

options.zh: 等重抽結果出來再決定

why.zh: 心電圖已經在說話了。等待是用她的心臟在賭。
why.en: The ECG is already speaking. Waiting gambles with her heart.

options.zh: 請她深呼吸放鬆，可能是緊張
options.en: Ask her to relax and breathe; probably anxiety

why.zh: 尖 T 波不是緊張。這是高血鉀在心臟上留下的痕跡。
why.en: Peaked T waves are not anxiety. That is potassium writing on the heart.

post.zh: 上機了，透析液依醫囑。阿姨，下次孫子生日，蛋糕可以，水果我們再談。
post.en: She is on, dialysate per orders. Mrs Chang, next birthday the cake is fine; the fruit we discuss.

post.zh: 重抽結果回來了，還是高。溶血只是讓它看起來更高而已。
post.en: The repeat is back, still high. The haemolysis only made it look even higher.

guide.en: Fen has brought something

lines.zh: 醫師，我翻了一整晚。三年前漁會健檢的報告，這個對嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, I went through everything all night. The fishermen's association health check from three years ago. Is this the one?

lines.zh: 對，就是這個。上面有肌酸酐。小芬，這張紙改變了整個判斷。
lines.en: Yes, exactly this. It has a creatinine on it. Fen, this sheet of paper changes the whole picture.

lines.zh: 三年前就比正常高一些。所以他是慢性腎病上面疊了一個急性損傷。兩個問題，不是一個。
lines.en: Already a little above normal three years ago. So this is an acute injury on top of chronic disease. Two problems, not one.

guide.en: Check the fluid balance chart

lines.zh: （經過）尿量表在這裡。導尿管放了之後第一個小時出很多，現在穩定了。
lines.en: (Passing) The urine chart is here. A lot came out in the first hour after the catheter; it has settled now.

lines.zh: 這就是為什麼早上要先開尿量表。你現在有趨勢了。
lines.en: That is why the urine chart went up this morning. Now you have a trend.

post.zh: 容量、藥物、阻塞。三個都在，三個都在處理。這才叫急性腎損傷的評估。
post.en: Volume, drugs, obstruction. All three present, all three being addressed. That is what assessing an acute kidney injury means.

guide.en: Check the fluid balance chart

lines.zh: （經過）尿量表？早上沒有醫囑，我們沒有分時段記。導尿管放了之後尿了多少，我只能估。
lines.en: (Passing) The urine chart? There was no order this morning, so we did not chart it hourly. How much came out after the catheter, I can only estimate.

lines.zh: 半天的尿量不見了。腎臟剛剛對你說了六個小時的話，你沒有在聽。現在開始記。
lines.en: Half a day of urine output, lost. The kidney has been talking to you for six hours and you were not listening. Start charting now.

post.zh: 容量、藥物、阻塞。三個都在。從現在起，每小時的尿量就是你的基準。
post.en: Volume, drugs, obstruction. All three present. From now on, the hourly urine output is your baseline.

guide.en: Read the consult, meet Kai

sub.zh: 32 歲男性茶色尿、眼皮腫、新發高血壓
sub.en: 32-year-old man: tea-coloured urine, puffy eyelids, new hypertension

lines.zh: 醫師，我只是太累。外送一天跑十二小時，眼睛腫很正常吧？尿的顏色可能是沒喝水。
lines.en: Doctor, I am just tired. Twelve hours a day on deliveries, puffy eyes are normal, right? The urine colour is probably from not drinking.

lines.zh: 茶色尿、眼皮腫、血壓高，三個一起出現，我想親自看你的尿。
lines.en: Tea-coloured urine, puffy eyelids, high blood pressure, all three together. I want to look at your urine myself.

lines.zh: 對。檢驗單寫「血尿」只是兩個字。腎臟科醫師自己看沉渣。顯微鏡在哪？
lines.en: Right. 'Haematuria' on a lab slip is just a word. Nephrologists look at the sediment themselves. Where is the microscope?

q.zh: 找到護理站角落的尿沉渣顯微鏡
q.en: Find the sediment microscope in the corner of the station

post.zh: 離心、倒掉上清、一滴沉渣、蓋玻片。低倍：紅血球圓柱。高倍：滿視野的變形紅血球。
post.en: Spin, decant, one drop, coverslip. Low power: red-cell casts. High power: a field full of dysmorphic red cells.

post.zh: 這些血不是從膀胱來的，是從腎絲球漏出來的。阿凱不是太累。
post.en: This blood is not from the bladder; it is leaking through the glomeruli. Kai is not just tired.

note.zh: 阿凱咳血，啟動肺腎評估

guide.zh: 接電話，到 PACS 看胸片
guide.en: Take the call, pull up the chest film

sub.zh: 阿凱咳出血絲，肌酸酐又升了
sub.en: Kai is coughing blood-streaked sputum; creatinine up again

lines.zh: 阿寬。阿凱剛剛咳出血絲，下午的肌酸酐比早上高。血氧還好，他有點怕。
lines.en: Kuan. Kai has just coughed up blood-streaked sputum, and this afternoon's creatinine is higher than this morning's. Saturation fine, he is a bit frightened.

lines.zh: 腎絲球加咳血。先把胸片調出來，核對名字和日期。
lines.en: Glomeruli plus haemoptysis. Pull up the chest film; check the name and date.

question.zh: 腎絲球血尿的病人開始咳血，胸片要幫你回答什麼？
question.en: A patient with glomerular haematuria starts coughing blood. What should the chest film answer?

answer.zh: 兩側肺野有沒有新的瀰漫性浸潤，那可能是肺泡出血。肺和腎同時出問題，要想同一個免疫疾病攻擊兩個器官，緊急整合評估，不能分開處理。
answer.en: Whether there are new diffuse infiltrates in both lung fields, which could be alveolar haemorrhage. Lungs and kidneys failing together points to one immune disease attacking two organs: urgent joined-up assessment, never handled separately.

post.zh: 這是肺腎症候群要排除的時候。免疫科、胸腔科、腎臟科，今天晚上就要一起談。
post.en: This is when a pulmonary-renal syndrome must be excluded. Immunology, chest and renal talk together tonight, not tomorrow.

guide.en: Decide the escalation with the mentor

lines.zh: 腎功能在惡化，又咳血。這不是明天門診的事。
lines.en: Kidney function is worsening and he is coughing blood. This is not a clinic problem for tomorrow.

lines.zh: 對。速度很重要。你的交班要怎麼寫，讓接手的人也跑起來？
lines.en: Right. Speed matters. How do you write the handover so the next person runs too?

post.zh: 好。跨器官線索加惡化速度，這兩件事不能分開寫。
post.en: Good. Cross-organ clues and the pace of deterioration are never written apart.

post.zh: 醫師……我今晚不能回去跑單了對吧。
post.en: Doctor... I am not going back out on deliveries tonight, am I.

post.zh: 今晚你的工作是讓我們把答案找出來。
post.en: Tonight your job is to let us find the answer.

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 5 床阿海伯：慢性腎病疊急性損傷，三個原因，導尿管已放，舊值在病歷裡，尿量每小時記。
lines.en: Bed 5, Mr Hai: acute injury on chronic disease, three causes, catheter in, old value in the notes, hourly urine output charted.

lines.zh: 張阿姨：高血鉀已透析，心電圖恢復，明天回門診談飲食。阿凱：腎絲球血尿加咳血，肺腎評估進行中。
lines.en: Mrs Chang: potassium dialysed, ECG normalised, diet talk in clinic tomorrow. Kai: glomerular haematuria with haemoptysis, pulmonary-renal work-up under way.

lines.zh: 阿凱的部分，把「速度」寫進去。誰負責追免疫科的回覆？
lines.en: For Kai, write in the pace. Who is chasing immunology's reply?

lines.zh: 我。電話留在交班單上。
lines.en: Me. My number is on the handover sheet.

guide.en: Take-off and machine disinfection

lines.zh: 下機後廔管壓迫止血、再聽一次雜音、機器跑消毒程序。明天早上它還要再囉嗦一輪。
lines.en: After take-off: pressure on the fistula, listen to the bruit once more, run the machine's disinfection cycle. It will be chatty again tomorrow morning.

lines.zh: 張阿姨的廔管還好嗎？
lines.en: Is Mrs Chang's fistula all right?

lines.zh: 好得很。她走的時候問我，葡萄算水果嗎。
lines.en: Perfectly. On her way out she asked me whether grapes count as fruit.

guide.en: Write today's progress notes

lines.zh: 你把阿海伯的三個問題寫成三個答案，把舊值貼進病歷，把阿凱的沉渣所見畫下來。畫得很醜，但是對的。
lines.en: You turn Mr Hai's three questions into three answers, paste the old value into the chart, and sketch Kai's sediment findings. Ugly drawings, but correct.

guide.en: The mentor's debrief

lines.zh: 今天你學到腎臟科的三件事：先找基準、自己看尿、檢體有問題不代表病人沒問題。
lines.en: Three things from nephrology today: find the baseline first, look at the urine yourself, and a faulty sample does not mean a healthy patient.

lines.zh: 阿海伯那張舊報告，是他女兒找到的，不是我們。記得謝謝她。
lines.en: Mr Hai's old report was found by his daughter, not by us. Remember to thank her.

lines.zh: 師傅，你的小本子今天多了三個人。
lines.en: Dr Chou, your notebook has three more people in it today.

lines.zh: 四個。我把你也記進去了。
lines.en: Four. I wrote you in as well.

note.zh: 夜間處理解除阻塞後多尿

guide.en: Take the call, back to bed 5

sub.en: Mr Hai is passing a great deal of urine

lines.zh: 阿寬。5 床導尿管放了之後，尿量這幾個小時一直很多，比喝進去的多。血壓還好，他說口渴。
lines.en: Kuan. Bed 5 has been passing a great deal of urine for hours since the catheter went in, more than he is drinking. Pressure fine, he says he is thirsty.

lines.zh: 解除阻塞後多尿。尿量繼續每小時記，依醫囑補充與追電解質，我過去看他的容量。
lines.en: Post-obstructive diuresis. Keep charting hourly, replace and check electrolytes per orders, and I will come and assess his volume.

lines.zh: 醫師，我這輩子沒尿過這麼多。這是好事還是壞事？
lines.en: Doctor, I have never passed this much in my life. Is that good or bad?

lines.zh: 是腎臟終於在說話。我們的工作是聽清楚，然後跟上。
lines.en: It is your kidneys finally talking. Our job is to listen carefully and keep up.

sub.zh: 一個肌酸酐沒有意義，兩個才有
sub.en: One creatinine means nothing; two mean something
